meta_description: Blurox Local Trusted Locksmiths Manchester provides 24/7 emergency lockout, lock repair and installation across Manchester. Fast response, fair prices.
hero_eyebrow: 24/7 Emergency Response — Locked Out? We're On Our Way
hero_subhead: Locked out of your home or business in Manchester? We arrive in under 60 minutes, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency lockouts to high-security installations, we handle every lock issue fast and fairly.

services.title: Emergency Lockouts
services.desc: Locked out of your home, flat, or business? We arrive rapidly with no call-out charge and open most locks without damage using professional techniques.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken, worn, or stuck locks fixed on the spot. We carry a wide range of replacement locks and can upgrade to higher-security options to suit your needs.

services.title: Residential Lock Installation
services.desc: New door and window locks fitted to the highest standards. We advise on security upgrades and install cylinders, mortice locks, and composite door hardware.

services.title: Commercial Lock Systems
services.desc: Master key systems, access control upgrades, and emergency re-keying for offices, shops, and industrial premises across Manchester.

services.title: Burglary Damage Repairs
services.desc: Swift emergency response to break-ins. We repair or replace damaged frames and locks and can secure your property immediately while you arrange further work.

services.title: Lock Upgrades & Security Advice
services.desc: We assess your property's security and recommend appropriate upgrades — from BS 3621 mortice locks to anti-snap cylinders — tailored to your budget.

about_pullquote: I started this business to prove locksmiths needn't be expensive or unreliable.
about_para_1: Blurox Local Trusted Locksmiths has built a reputation across Manchester for honest, fast emergency locksmith work. We operate 24/7 because we know lock problems don't happen during office hours. Every callout receives the same priority and professionalism, whether you're a homeowner locked out at 2am or a business manager facing a security breach.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we charge fairly, arrive promptly, and leave your locks working better than before. We don't use cowboy tactics or inflated emergency pricing — just straightforward repairs and installations done right the first time. Based in Old Trafford and serving all of greater Manchester, we're your local trusted locksmith.
reviews_heading: What Manchester Customers Say About Blurox Locksmiths

reviews.text: Got locked out of my flat in Stretford at 11pm on a Sunday. Rang Blurox and the lad was here in 45 minutes. Opened the door without any damage, very professional, and the price was reasonable. Top service.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Called them for a broken lock on my business premises. They came out same day, sorted it quickly, and fitted a much better lock. Been using them ever since. Honest and efficient.
reviews.author: Priya P.

reviews.text: Had my daughter locked in the bathroom by accident. Rang them in a panic and they were amazing — got here fast, got her out safely, and wouldn't even charge us. Brilliant blokes, can't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Sarah L.
